title: A site changes its look with a brand pack of tokens
description:
Colours, fonts, logo and spacing must be data so the shared deployment can accept them.

```gherkin
Feature: Brand pack

  Scenario: Tokens restyle the site
    Given a brand pack that sets colours for light and dark, fonts and a logo
    When the site is built
    Then every page uses those values
    And the layout is unchanged

  Scenario: A brand pack cannot carry code
    Given a brand pack that includes a script or arbitrary CSS rules
    When it is saved
    Then it is refused with the reason
```

**Needs Papyrus work:** PPY-e572de, PPY-0f4e10, PPY-2a44b2.
